# EMPLOYMENT OFFER LETTER

[Company Letterhead]

Date: [DATE]

[Candidate Name]
[Address]
[City, State ZIP]

Dear [Candidate Name],

We are pleased to extend an offer of employment for the position of **Senior Software Engineer** at [COMPANY NAME]. We believe your skills and experience in software development will be a valuable addition to our engineering team.

## Position Details

**Title:** Senior Software Engineer
**Department:** Engineering
**Reports To:** [Engineering Manager Name / VP of Engineering]
**Location:** [Office Location / Remote]
**Start Date:** [Proposed Start Date]
**Employment Type:** Full-Time, Exempt

## Compensation

**Base Salary:** $[AMOUNT] per year, paid [bi-weekly / semi-monthly], subject to applicable withholdings.

**Bonus:** Eligible for an annual discretionary bonus of up to [X]% of base salary, based on company and individual performance. Bonus eligibility requires active employment on the payment date.

**Equity:** [X] stock options subject to the terms of the Company's equity incentive plan, vesting over four (4) years with a one (1)-year cliff, as detailed in a separate Stock Option Agreement.

## Benefits

You will be eligible for our standard benefits package, including:
- Health insurance (medical, dental, vision) effective [date]
- 401(k) with [X]% company match
- [X] days paid time off per year
- [X] paid holidays
- [Other benefits: e.g., professional development stipend, wellness benefit]

Full details will be provided during onboarding.

## Contingencies

This offer is contingent upon:
- Successful completion of a background check
- Verification of your legal right to work in [Country]
- Execution of required standard employment documents, including:
  - Confidentiality Agreement
  - Intellectual Property Assignment Agreement
  - [Other standard onboarding documents, if applicable]

## At-Will Employment

Please note that employment with [Company Name] is at-will. This means that either you or the Company may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without cause or notice. This offer letter does not constitute a contract of employment for any specific period.

## Acceptance

To accept this offer, please sign below and return by [DEADLINE DATE]. This offer will expire if not accepted by that date.

We are excited about the possibility of you joining our engineering team. If you have any questions, please contact [HR Contact] at [email/phone].

Sincerely,

_________________________
[Hiring Manager Name]
[Title]
[Company Name]

---

## ACCEPTANCE

I accept this offer of employment and agree to the terms stated above.

Signature: _________________________

Printed Name: _________________________

Date: _________________________

Anticipated Start Date: _________________________

---

**Notes for finalizing:**
- Replace all bracketed `[PLACEHOLDERS]` with company-specific details before sending.
- This template is for informational purposes only and does not constitute legal advice; have qualified legal counsel review before use, as employment law varies by jurisdiction.
- Keep the standard Confidentiality and IP Assignment agreements as separate exhibits — no clauses restricting lawful reporting of illegal activity, and any restrictive covenants should be reasonable in scope and compliant with local law.
